data.action: 单手支颐侧卧在草地野餐垫上，发丝铺散，神情慵懒戏弄地看着视角
data.camera: cowboy shot, diagonal angle, relaxing lawn view
data.description: 春日微风吹拂的青青草地上，红白格子的野餐垫上散落着精美的三明治与果汁。C.C.侧卧在松软的草地上，单手支着下巴，翠绿的长发如绿色锦缎般铺展在花草之间。她嘴里衔着一根青草，微眯起金珀色的眼眸注视着正在看书的你，嘴角挂着一丝戏谑的慵懒——「书有什么好看的，难道我还不如那几张纸有趣吗？」
data.lighting: 透过树梢洒下温暖和煦的金色春日阳光
data.location: 开满雏菊与蒲公英的湖畔青草地野餐垫上
data.promptProse: C.C. lies on her side in an ivory sweater, propping her chin in one hand and keeping an eye on the reader over a grass stem. Her long green hair spreads over the blanket, where her companion in a navy linen shirt sits upright. Short brown curls frame the reader's face as they look down at the book. Dappled sun reaches the sandwiches and juice.
data.title: C.C. · 阳光草坪的慵懒侧卧
data.animaCaption: Long green-haired C.C. lies on one side of the picnic blanket with a grass stem between her lips. The short curly-haired reader in a navy linen shirt sits at the other edge with an open book.
